items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I was there when Basie's band checked in from Kansas City, too.

ctx.x: Like the President was for the white musicians in New York.
That's right, that's right. And, gee whiz, Count Basie's band stayed in there. Erskine Hawkin(s) band. I was standing out in front of the hotel when Erskine's band drove up from Alabama /state.
